prose:
Synth Patch Hero presents a browser-based modular-synthesis game in which players match a reference sound by connecting modules and adjusting controls. The readable landing interface describes a series of gigs, a ninety-percent matching target and an incentive to return with a cheaper patch.

This is a description of the game and its interface, not a hands-on assessment of audio quality, scoring validity or educational outcomes. Its story about earning money belongs to the game, not a real paid-work offer. The source does not explain an AI training or inference method, so placement in an AI-oriented feed should not be mistaken for evidence that its synthesizer uses AI. No audio was played, progress cleared or browser setting changed.
highlights: Game teaches synthesis through reference matching
Patching and knob adjustment are central mechanics
Interface mentions ear and graph comparison
Ninety percent is an in-game matching target
No AI mechanism is established by the source
No gameplay or audio test was performed
